City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JULY 15, 2015 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Board Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 6/10/15 Special Joint Meeting, 6/17/15 Special Meeting and the 6/17/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S8B - Warrants
8C.
Acceptance of City of Encinitas Tract No. 03-090, Coral Cove Public Water Improvements. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion.
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S8C - NOC Coral Cove
8D.
License Agreement with Crown Castle GT Company LLC to allow Communications Facilities on San Dieguito Water District Property. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell (Attachment A updated on 7/13/2015)
Authorize the General Manager to enter into a new License Agreement (Agreement) with Crown Castle GT Company LLC (Crown) to allow the communications facilities on San Dieguito Water District property located near Manchester Avenue.
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S8D - Crown Castle License Agreement
8E.
San Dieguito Water District's Quarterly Monthly Informational Update and Analysis. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell
Accept San Dieguito Water District's Monthly Informational Update and Analysis..
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S8E - Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Presentation of the Results of the San Dieguito Water District Pension Funding Study.  Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell.
District Board receive the presentation, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S10A - SDWD Pension Funding Study
10B.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2015-08 authorizing the execution of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the San Dieguito Water District (District) and Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Local 221; adoption of Resolution No. 2015-09 approving salary and benefit changes for Unrepresented employees; adoption of Resolution No. 2015-10 approving the titles and pay ranges of the San Dieguito Water District; and adoption of Resolution No. 2015-11 amending the Fiscal Year (FY) 2015-16 budget to incorporate the costs of the approved changes. Contact Persons: Risk Manager Schwarm and HR Manager Dunphy
Adopt Resolution No. 2015-08 authorizing the City Manager or designee(s) to execute, on behalf of the San Dieguito Water District, a Memorandum of Understanding between the District and Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Local 221 incorporating the terms of the Tentative Agreements which have been ratified by SEIU. Adopt Resolution 2015-09, approving salary and benefit adjustments for Unrepresented employees as authorized by the Board of Directors during Closed Session on July 8, 2015. Adopt Resolution No. 2015-10 adopting the FY2015-16 Position Title and Pay Range Schedule for all San Dieguito Water District employees. Adopt Resolution No. 2015-11 amending the budget for FY2015-16 to incorporate salary and benefit changes for employees of SEIU and Unrepresented employees as authorized by the Board of Directors in Resolution 2015-08 (SEIU) and Resolution 2015-09 (Unrepresented).
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S10B - SEIU -UNREP
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Informational Presentation on Water Conservation Programs Offered to San Dieguito Water District Customers.  Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell.
District Board receive the presentation, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S11A - Presentation on Water Conservation Programs
11B.
Informational presentation on the Drought and the District's response to the State Water Resources Control Board's Emergency Regulations. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell
District Board receive the presentation, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2015-07-15 SDWD Item S11B - Presentation on Drought and Response to SWRCB's Emergency Regulations
10B.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2015-08 authorizing the execution of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the San Dieguito Water District (District) and Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Local 221; adoption of Resolution No. 2015-09 approving salary and benefit changes for Unrepresented employees; adoption of Resolution No. 2015-10 approving the titles and pay ranges of the San Dieguito Water District; and adoption of Resolution No. 2015-11 amending the Fiscal Year (FY) 2015-16 budget to incorporate the costs of the approved changes. Contact Persons: Risk Manager Schwarm and HR Manager Dunphy
Adopt Resolution No. 2015-08 authorizing the City Manager or designee(s) to execute, on behalf of the San Dieguito Water District, a Memorandum of Understanding between the District and Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Local 221 incorporating the terms of the Tentative Agreements which have been ratified by SEIU. Adopt Resolution 2015-09, approving salary and benefit adjustments for Unrepresented employees as authorized by the Board of Directors during Closed Session on July 8, 2015. Adopt Resolution No. 2015-10 adopting the FY2015-16 Position Title and Pay Range Schedule for all San Dieguito Water District employees. Adopt Resolution No. 2015-11 amending the budget for FY2015-16 to incorporate salary and benefit changes for employees of SEIU and Unrepresented employees as authorized by the Board of Directors in Resolution 2015-08 (SEIU) and Resolution 2015-09 (Unrepresented).
S12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY BOARD MEMBERS
S13.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S14.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
S15.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
